source.note: Kenney boat-sail-a (GLB with the kit colormap), same kit and fetch pin as boat-fishing. Small sloop: height 8.0 m keel to masthead (mast about 7 m above the deck) gives a 6.36 m hull and 3.0 m beam (chunky toy proportions, beam and freeboard on the generous side). y = 0 is the hull bottom; the waterline sits at about y = 0.5 m (below the gunwale band at 1.0 m), so a film sinks the boat 0.5 m into its water plane. Bow faces image-left in the lab left view: jib forward, mainsail on a boom aft. Cream hull and sails, red gunwale band, deck and cabin roof (the source orange-red), dark-brown mast and boom. The sails are thin closed wedges, so they draw from both sides without doubleSided. Static, no clips.
